description: This file defines the MergeStatus class and companion object, which manage the status information for merged shuffle partition blocks in Apache Spark's scheduler. It includes serialization logic, methods for handling merge status data, and conversion from external shuffle service responses.

classes.name: MergeStatus
classes.description: Represents the merge status of shuffle partition blocks, including location, merge ID, bitmap of map outputs, and total size. Implements Externalizable for custom serialization.

methods.name: getNumMissingMapOutputs
methods.description: Returns the count of missing map outputs based on the bitmap.

methods.name: writeExternal
methods.description: Serializes the MergeStatus object to an external output.

methods.name: readExternal
methods.description: Deserializes the MergeStatus object from an external input.
